label: Trackdesk
description: Manage affiliates, offers, coupons, conversions, notes, tags and tiers

operations.name: list_affiliates
operations.description: List affiliates in your program, one page at a time.

operations.name: get_affiliate
operations.description: Read an affiliate by its account UUID.

operations.name: create_affiliate
operations.description: Register an affiliate; sending the welcome email is an explicit option.

operations.name: set_affiliate_status
operations.description: Change an affiliate's traffic status using its public ID.

operations.name: set_affiliate_tier
operations.description: Assign a payout tier to an affiliate by public ID.

operations.name: list_offers
operations.description: List offers including pricing and landing pages.

operations.name: get_offer
operations.description: Read an offer including pricing and landing pages.

operations.name: list_coupons
operations.description: List coupons, optionally filtering by affiliate or offer.

operations.name: create_coupon
operations.description: Create a coupon for one affiliate traffic source and offer.

operations.name: delete_coupon
operations.description: Delete a coupon by its UUID.

operations.name: create_conversion
operations.description: Record a click-attributed conversion with an external ID for deduplication.

operations.name: set_conversion_status
operations.description: Change the status of an existing conversion.

operations.name: list_account_notes
operations.description: List the notes attached to one affiliate account.

operations.name: create_account_note
operations.description: Add a note to an affiliate account.

operations.name: delete_account_note
operations.description: Delete a single affiliate account note.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: List your program's tags; also used to verify the connection.

operations.name: get_tag
operations.description: Read a tag by its UUID.

operations.name: create_tag
operations.description: Create a colored tag for the selected resource scope.

operations.name: list_tiers
operations.description: List your program's affiliate payout tiers.

operations.name: get_tier
operations.description: Read an affiliate tier and its payout rates.

operations.name: build_tracking_link
